findings.title: Exclude entrant input notes from shared continuity exports
findings.why_it_matters: The continuity copy labeled as safe to share includes the teacher's raw entrant notes, alongside the generated group material. renderJoin places JOIN_FIELDS inputs inside the printable pane without a privacy marker; printable(false) converts their values into visible spans and only removes .sens blocks. The existing DOM fixture, extended in memory with a synthetic J.form.notes sentinel, confirmed that the sentinel appears in printShare. Removing the input section from shared export preserves the generated welcome plan while keeping the teacher's private context separate.

findings.title: Clear the previous entrant's kit when starting anew
findings.why_it_matters: Starting a new entrant route leaves the previous entrant's form, welcome message, first task and role cards visible and printable. The reset clears only progress fields, so even the information previously permitted for the old entrant's group message remains active for the next entrant. A synthetic click through the existing DOM fixture confirmed that the old kit and input notes survive and the old first task still appears in the shared export. Resetting entrant-specific state while retaining J.info implements the documented new-route behavior.
